item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Germany participated as an observer in the second Meeting of States Parties to the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons, held in New York from 27 November to 1 December 2023. Germany had not joined the treaty because its prohibitions conflict with NATO obligations such as nuclear sharing. The German Government reaffirmed its goal of a world without nuclear weapons, identified the NPT as its central disarmament and non-proliferation framework, developed proposals through the Stockholm Initiative to strengthen the NPT, and intended to continue dialogue with TPNW states on nuclear disarmament.","notes":["The excerpt supports that Germany had not joined because of conflicts with NATO obligations, but does not explicitly describe a contemporaneous decision to decline membership."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Federal Audit Office reported that the federal government financed €23.9 billion of Länder and municipal tasks in 2021, while the federal share of total tax revenue had fallen to about 38% from 48% in 1991. It recommended that the federal government review its payments to the Länder and called for clearer financial responsibility between levels of government.","notes":["The excerpt recommends reviewing federal Leistungen to the Länder; it does not specifically use the term 'transfers.'"]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Germany endorsed a joint statement on addressing the North Korean nuclear challenge together with a broad coalition of states and the European Union.","notes":["The supplied excerpt identifies the statement and endorsers, including Germany and the European Union, but does not contain the 11 August 2023 date."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
